_comment: The shared transfer market: listing price bounds, bid steps, AI seller listings and listing limits. Every player sees the same market.
_priceBoundsComment: A card's listing price range (PLAN 4.1). The maximum is the first band whose fromRating the card reaches, else defaultMaximum; special cards (rareflag above 1) have specialMinimum and a maximum of at least specialMaximumFloor, never above specialMaximumCap.
_sellerTaxComment: The transfer tax (PLAN 4.1): the seller of a sale receives the price less sellerTaxPercent (the tax rounded up). The tax is deleted: the economy's main coin sink. AI sellers receive nothing.
_bidIncrementsComment: The smallest raise over the current bid: the step of the first band the bid is below, otherwise defaultBidIncrement.
_fairValueComment: An AI listing's reference price (PLAN 4.1; 75-80 raised to 1,100 on 2026-09-29 so the AI's lowest start, 0.72 x 0.9 x 1,100 = 713, stays above the 360/700 gold quick sell): byRating is a monotonic table for base cards, each value from its fromRating up to the next entry's (bands, the older formula, apply only when byRating is empty). Specials multiply by specialMultiplier + min(rareflag, 100) / specialRareflagDivisor. A stable per-card jitter of jitterMinimum + (hash % jitterSteps) / 100 is applied, then the price is clamped to the card's bounds.
_aiListingsComment: The AI Market Maker is disabled by default (target 0). When explicitly enabled, the maintenance job keeps up to target active AI listings (ULTIMATETEAM21_MARKET_TARGET overrides it), adding at most maxPerTopUp per pass. Start and Buy Now prices are drawn around the fair value; durations are picked from durationsSeconds. It lists only tradeable base cards of the rareflags named: never a special, a competition base card (47/48/52/53, owner decision D2), or a grant-only, Pro, custom or reward-only card. No card is rated above the ceiling of maxRatingSchedule: the latest entry whose from has passed, else the first (owner decision D7: 84 in the test week, 83 from public launch).
_listingsComment: Player listing durations are clamped to these bounds; searches and watchlists page with these defaults and limits. durations are FUT's listing durations (1, 3, 6 and 12 hours, 1 and 3 days): Re-list All gives a listing from before migration 057, which stored no duration, the longest that fits its times. bidExtensionSeconds: a bid with less time left than this puts the clock back to it, like retail FUT.
